data.reason: New R006 source-backed E1–E6 full-text preassessment of the ORIGINAL OPEN-ACCESS 2009 ARTICLE (not only abstract): E1: original Method > Participants states 36 adults in the main recognition experiment, 18 auditory and 18 visual. E2: Method > Stimuli/Auditory Natural Indicators/Auditory Symbolic Indicators specifies computer-delivered one-second auditory warnings paired with four critical aviation events (low fuel, carbon monoxide, ground proximity, engine fire); no claim that generic ambient noise alone qualifies. E3: Aim/Design describes a 2x2x2 factorial experiment: between-person auditory versus visual modality, within-person natural versus symbolic indicators and low versus high dual-task demand. E4: Results and Tables 4–5 report accuracy and response times during learning and test; their numerical cells were viewed but NOT extracted into canonical outcome records. E5: real primary experiment, Methods, Procedure and Results inspected. E6: 2009 article dated May 4, before frozen 2026-10-04 cutoff; DOI 10.2478/v10053-008-0064-6. Thus source TEXT supports Track E eligibility in a tool-mediated, provisional sense. Crucial identity correction: Methods > Stimuli separately reports N=40 in a prior indicator-association stimulus-selection rating task; these are not part of the 36-person recognition main experiment and cannot be added to the empirical main N or counted as another independent included sample from metadata. Eighteen auditory and eighteen visual participants are arms of the same experiment, not two independent studies. Both learning and test phases, and natural/symbolic conditions, are repeated observations—not independent sample multipliers. The article explicitly contrasts earlier Perry 2007 training, but interpublication participant overlap remains UNKNOWN without source-by-source cohort comparison; different design alone is no independence certificate. Factual limitations: publisher-linked original article HTML was consulted through an intermediary, not raw HTTP original XML/PDF bytes; source has no canonical manifestation, R006 has no performed manifestation-bound AID, no audio file inspection or authenticated human second assessment. The graph contract therefore precludes canonical full-text include/exclude and the decision remains PENDING. R004/Integration should secure lawful exact-byte provenance and register a source manifestation, then R006 must perform source-pinned verification/adjudication; do not infer numerical effect estimates, publication-level inclusion or sample admission.
